verdict: Front matter and Chapter 1 are close to ready. The Contents page numbers were spot-checked against 24 headings and all match, and every Chapter 1 citation was checked against S_full.txt and studies_brief.txt: the [1]–[31] citations are appropriate for the sentences they support, and the Chapter 1 use of SLR studies [37, 43, 44, 45, 53, 57, 58, 61, 63, 66, 69, 71, 76] is consistent with their coding and with the rebuilt Section 2.5 (multi-party approval exists in six classes; the gap is the conjunction and its assurance). Two abstract errors must be fixed before submission: the study count (33 instead of 44) and the opening claim that existing systems do not establish identity, authority or collective approval, which contradicts the retraction in Chapter 2 and Chapter 1's own Section 1.2; the opening of Section 1.3 also refers to 'four foundational dimensions' before introducing them and should be made self-contained. Sepolia facts (contract 0x0EC3…Dc73, chainId 11155111, 23 automated tests, jurisdiction denial, on-chain revocation, N-of-N over G, independent verification) and the RO statuses in the abstract and Table 1 agree with Chapters 6, 7 and 9.
